snippet.title: Heat 'n Hit: The Blacksmith Simulator 🔥 Forge, Explore & Craft | General Trailer (v0.2.0)
snippet.description:
🔨 Forge legendary weapons, explore mysterious dungeons, and uncover the truth behind your grandfather’s disappearance in Heat 'n Hit: The Blacksmith Simulator!

Step into the role of a blacksmith in a medieval fantasy world. Inherit your missing grandfather’s workshop, forge legendary weapons, and rise from apprentice to legend.

Explore distant cities and perilous dungeons, gather rare materials, and unlock new crafting mechanics and cosmetic items. Customize your smithy, master your skills, and uncover the mystery behind your grandfather’s disappearance.

🛠️ Features:
• Blacksmithing and crafting system
• Dungeon exploration and material gathering
• Unlockable mechanics and cosmetic items
• Story-driven mystery

🎮 Play the free demo now on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3927410/Heat_n_Hit_Prologue/

📣 Join the Discord – Share Your Feedback & Ideas!
https://discord.gg/acaNdrshxS

📘 Trailer recorded from Beta Version 0.2.0 (September 2025)
Features and visuals are subject to change.

#HeatnHit #BlacksmithSimulator #IndieGame #FantasyRPG #SteamDemo #CraftingGame #DungeonCrawler #RPGDemo #IndieDev
